title: Broncos OLB Jonathon Cooper has been removed from the Commissioner’s exempt list

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos OLB Jonathon Cooper has been removed from the Commissioner’s exempt list
sources.description: According to 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis, the NFL has removed Denver Broncos edge rusher Jonathon Cooper from the Commissioner’s exempt list. The Broncos veteran starting edge rusher will be eligible to play vs. the Cardinals next week. Earlier this week, it was reported that Cooper’s trial date was pushed back to March, instead of in […]
